title: Make Position Uninformative: Exchangeable Self-Distillation Flattens the Lost-in-the-Middle Curve
abstract: arXiv:2611.28638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models answer well when the relevant document comes first or last and poorly when it sits in the middle. Some fine-tuning recipes lift the middle by lowering the start. We show how training contexts teach positional bias. With a uniform answer slot and shuffled distractors, the optimal reader ignores position. Building on this result, Exchangeable Self-Distillation (ExSD) trains a small adapter on shuffled contexts to reproduce the model's answer when it reads the answer document alone. It needs no gold answers and only a few thousand examples. On six models from 1.5B to 32B parameters, ExSD raises both average and worst-position accuracy against the frozen model, including on a held-out test split. In controlled LoRA comparisons, it significantly improves both criteria over Pos2Distill. translated_title: 使位置信息失效：可交换自蒸馏抹平“中间迷失”曲线
translated_abstract: 检索增强型语言模型在相关文档位于开头或末尾时回答效果良好，而当相关文档位于中间时回答效果较差。一些微调方法通过降低开头位置的准确率来提升中间位置的准确率。我们展示了训练上下文是如何教授位置偏差的。通过统一的答案槽位和打乱顺序的干扰项，最优阅读器会忽略位置信息。基于这一结果，可交换自蒸馏在打乱顺序的上下文上训练一个小型适配器，使其复现模型单独阅读答案文档时的答案。该方法不需要标准答案，且只需几千个样本。在参数量从1.5B到32B的六个模型上，ExSD相对于冻结模型提升了平均准确率和最差位置的准确率，包括在留出的测试集上也是如此。在受控的LoRA对比实验中，它在两项指标上都显著优于Pos2Distill。与CORD相比，平均差异并不显著，但最差位置准确率在20-和3...（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出可交换自蒸馏方法，无需标准答案、仅用几千个打乱上下文的样本训练小型适配器，即可抹平检索增强语言模型的“中间迷失”位置偏差，同时提升平均准确率和最差位置准确率。
en_tdlr: Exchangeable Self-Distillation (ExSD) trains a small adapter on shuffled contexts without gold answers, using only a few thousand examples to flatten the lost-in-the-middle curve in retrieval-augmented LMs, improving both average and worst-position accuracy.
